run_robodesk_env: run a robodesk environment by creating a RoboDesk instance, resetting it, and stepping with an action vector
create_robodesk_instance: create a RoboDesk environment instance using robodesk.RoboDesk() for reinforcement learning tasks
reset_robodesk_env: reset the robodesk environment to its initial state using the reset method
step_robodesk_env: step the robodesk environment forward with a 5-element action vector using the step method
import_robodesk_module: import the robodesk module to access the RoboDesk environment class for RL experiments
